weapon.description: A Yohmei-made sword with a unique form, containing the power of a creature that lives far to the east.
A sword contaminated with the genes of a hero that was infected with the D Factor. Awakens the user's strength.
A very high-end sword built with the finest parts and tuned for advanced users. Balanced well for ease of use.
A replica sword based on designs from the earliest days of photon weaponry.
A sword patterned after actual swords from pre-photonic newman history. Popular among antique buffs.
The ultimate work created by master craftsman Izo. There is nothing its blade can't cut.
A sword that makes a strong impact thanks to the attached photon blade. One hearty swing will demolish everything.
The ultimate sword that is part of Gurhal legend. It is said to have the power to cleave even planets in two.
A sword with an impressive design that catches the eye. Its cold shiny blue blade is reminiscent of the Grim Reaper.
A sword forged in the image of a blue dragon from legend which cuts through evil and darkness with incredible power.
The ultimate work created by master craftsman Izo. There is nothing its blade can't cut.
A rare sword made with ore from a distant star and unidentified gems.
A sword said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. Its rotating photon blades shred enemies to pieces.
A graceful sword that reminds one of a never-ending desert. Its age is unknown, but it was crafted with impressive skill.
A super high-end, limited-edition sword powered by the highest grade reactor. Its power can strike down a De Ragan with a single bow.
A cruel sword that spreads open wounds with its wavy blade and burns with its blazing flame.
A Yohmei-made sword with a unique form, containing the power of a creature that lives far to the south of the Gurhal System.
A sword crafted by the avant-garde designed Takemitsu. It is modeled after a mythical sea creature that appears only at night.
Legendary sword found in the ancient ruins.
This sword's massive blade cleaves great beasts with ease. If there is anything it cannot cut, it has yet to be discovered.
A replica sword based on designs from the earliest days of photon weaponry.
A Yohmei-made sword with a unique form, containing the power of a creature that lives far to the west.
A limited-run top-of-the-line sword. Few can control its destructive power.
A replica sword based on designs from the earliest days of photon weaponry.
A reproduced sword based on a weapon excavated from an ancient archeological site. Considerable talent is required to handle it.
A sword whose blue blade emits a powerful radiance which resonates with the owner's spirit, capable of cleaving a planet in two.
A sword modeled after former Endrum Collective commander Renvolt Magashi. It unleashes its war cry with every vicious slice.
A condemned sword that admits its bearer to the underworld. The blade becomes stronger the closer its wielder strays towards death's door.
A legendary sword that is said to be hoarded by dragons. Draws power from its master to fuel fell blasts with every strike.
A legendary sword that is said to be hoarded by an Ogra Dyran. The creature's vile pulse can be felt in its grip.
A mysterious sword with a unique form, containing the power of a creature that lives far to the north.
A special combat mode weapon designed to use the same barrel as a rifle and anti-tank gun. Great against slicing through bullets and enemies.
Owned by Orochi Agito, this blade was forged with an incredible power that is no longer sealed.
A sword whose blue blade emits a powerful radiance which resonates with the owner's spirit, capable of cleaving a planet in two.
A sword that proves the owner to be a madam. An article of pure refinement.
Super high-end custom knuckles with multiple photon horns. The destructive power in each horn combines to make them unstoppable.
Knuckles that boost power in hand-to-hand combat. A superior weapon that enhances the power of your punches to its theoretical limits.
Blades ripped off of a Grinna Bete S before it was completely scrapped.
Knuckles developed by Yohmei Corp. Uses their large-capacity reactor to split photons into two streams, increasing accuracy.
Powerful, high-spec knuckles geared toward advanced users. Their high specs are balanced well with ease of use.
Unusual one-handed knuckles with a brutal appearance and unrivaled power. Created using a rare metal, it shines a bright gold.
A replica of knuckles from the pre-photonic era, originally used to dig underground. A good conversation piece, but not very useful in combat.
Knuckles for those with unshakable self-conviction. They glow with a warrior's emblem as their photons fuse with your martial spirit.
Knuckles created using the arms of a Bil De Melan. Their destructive power has been enhanced greatly.
Mysterious knuckles with a pale shimmer. They are said to contain the mysterious power to freeze opponents.
These knuckles modeled after part of Mother Brain have been fitted with an advanced targeting system to enhance the wielder's accuracy.
GRM knuckles designed with an aerodynamic form. Made using powerful photons, they are constantly overflowing with light.
Super high-end custom knuckles with a large-capacity reactor, they scar their victims in the shape of a cross.
Super high-end, custom knuckles popular for their unique photon horn.
Knuckles with an elegant design that contrasts their overwhelming destructive power. Each punch emits beautiful petal-like sparkles.
Knuckles that use compressed photons to achieve a powerful impact. The finely expelled photon mist resembles steam.
Knuckles developed by a master of many martial arts. These broaden the wielder's expertise for an edge in combat.
Rubbery soft knuckles bathed in a warm photon glow. While they appear both pliable and resilient, they pack a serious punch.
Ferocious knuckles modeled after the head of a beast from the inferno. The beast's thunderous roar reverberates with each punch.
Designed by Azutaka, these knuckles boast overwhelming destructive power. Their high-speed rotating cutter heads will demolish enemies.
Knuckles that drive back evil with a righteous explosive flame. Face down villains with the power of justice!
Ferocious knuckles modeled after the head of a wild animal. They echo the beast's thunderous roar with each attack.
Knuckles that are used to punish troublemakers at school.
Knuckles developed in order to have higher attack power for hand-to-hand combat. Ergonomically designed to insure a snug fit.
Knuckles in the shape of pom-poms like those used by a cheer squad. You'll boost your party's spirits if you fight with these. Go, go! Let's go!
A super high-end custom spear with a supplemental reactor, its multiple blades inflict great damage.
A top-of-the-line upgraded spear. While unstable, its destructive power is second to none.
A sinister red spear. A demon who appeared at night to attack people and drink their blood had transformed into this weapon upon his defeat.
A spear developed by Yohmei Corp. Uses its large-capacity reactor to split photons into two streams, increasing accuracy.
A replica spear of a weapon called "Geki" in ancient books. Its power is extraordinarily high since it can both stab and slash.
A weapon that combines the reach of a spear and the destructive power of an axe. The blade's complex shape creates sharp gusts of air.
A spear with a bright gemstone that radiates energy. The gemstone is said to have been forged from a god's spirit.
A spear shaped like a Christmas tree adorned with beautiful ornaments. Let's enjoy this glittering, holy night!
Thanks to attaching an axe blade to the handle, this spear excels at both range and power. Some skill is required to control its supreme power.
An assault spear from Yohmei Corp. With its dramatically increased photon output, it's a model only Yohmei could produce.
A spear developed based on Neudaiz legends. It is said to have been used by a legendary newman who could tame even Ubakrada.
A spear used by Yut Jun Yunkers, with traditional engravings of the Kasch people. Its primitive appearance belies considerable power.
A spear with a specialized tip for grabbing onto the enemy's blade and controlling them. Used by GUARDIANS and allied partners as anti-riot gear.
A spear said to have been made from the shards of fallen stars. Little else is know about it, however.
A spear crafted out of a rare, glowing white mineral. Its inorganic and yet sculpted design and detailing is the talk of the CAST community.
A spear resembling a native creature called an "Ubakrada." While looking for prey, it is eager to pounce on the target.
A noble spear used by the holy knight Hildegard. The added wings give it a beautiful form.
A modified spear modeled after an unearthed weapon. It is crafted for sharpness.
A recreation based on the remains of an enormous weapon. The rotation of this spear is supposed to increase its attack power to outrageous limits.
A high-end gag gift with a glove-shaped spearhead. The damage it did was no joke, however, and it was recalled by the manufacturer.
A spear capable of launching homing bombs. The bombs from rushdown attacks are so powerful they can smash through even tough armor.
A spear for those who dream of flying through the sky. Besides being a weapon, it was designed to give the sensation of riding a broom.
A spear which also fires bullets. It can pulverize even the strongest armor. This glimmering silver spear makes you look like a holy knight.
The archaeologist Chobi is said to have discovered this spear at a RELICS site. Holding it imbues its wielder with courage and uncommon strength.
A double saber from another dimension. With its tremendous power, you can shred to pieces anyone who stands in your way.
A double saber shrouded in mystery. Nothing is known about its capabilities.
A masterpiece that earned its maker recognition. Its blades mince foes instantly.
A prototype double saber with an overpowered reactor. Its stability is somewhat low for a GRM product, but its power more than makes up for it.
A super high-end, custom double saber made from the arms of a Carriguine. Its destructive power is immeasurable.
A super high-end, custom-made double round saber. Death awaits those fooled by its whimsical appearance.
An upgrade to the double saber Nyoibo, enhanced with Indigo Stones. Found forgotten in a storehouse, labeled as a mooring post for boats.
A double saber that slashes enemies with countless photon blades. No one can escape its death blow.
A double saber which features the reliefs of a certain brother and sister. Bravery and strength on one side, hope and kindness on the other.
A double saber linking Rengokuto Ensa and Rengokuto Guren. It feeds off the flesh and blood of its victims, preventing it from rusting.
A double saber restored for the new CAST model, "Vivienne." The delicate design hides its power well.
The crystals on both ends of this double saber can inflict a lot of damage. Its unrelenting attacks are like a meteor shower.
A custom-built double saber with two of the top-of-the-line reactors that powered the De Ragan Slayer sword.
A double saber with three-pronged blades. Due to its light weight, it can be used to instantly unleash a variety of attacks.
A double saber fitted with large blades for tearing its target apart. The mere sight of these blades is enough to strike fear into the staunchest of hearts.
A double saber created at the same time as the twin sabers Hyakkaryolan. It uses the aggression of enemies as a source of power.
A double saber with a unique shape that shimmers in the sun, named after a flower that yearns for sunlight.
A Little Wing Grand Prix winner, Ringo, jointly developed this double saber with GRM. Awarded by Hyuga to honor him.
A double saber wielded by security forces. It is a well-balanced design.
True to its name, this double saber rips targets apart with lightning-quick attacks. Only the very swift can hope to wield it.
A double saber with real and photon dual-layered blades. It was devised by a famous research facility professor under the alias "Freezer Lord."
A mass-produced axe based on a design from TENORA WORKS's new weapons development project. It matches the prototype in power.
An axe fashioned from meteorite ore. Its photons resonate with the twinkling of the stars, creating power enough to rend the very land.
An axe created by renowned poet Reffi in the image of a crescent moon shaped like an eyebrow.
An axe developed by Yohmei Corp. Its upgraded photon reactor sets it apart from other companies' products.
A super high-end custom axe with a unique double blade, its destructive power is quite astounding.
This axe, modeled after the sharp scythes of an Ill Gill, replicates the terrifying potency of its namesake.
An axe that bears the name Oka, given only to true masterpieces created by Yohmei Corp. Its power is so great as to endanger even its bearer.
Only the worthiest warriors can claim this axe from the Stateria that carries it.
An axe made from a large, satisfying portion of meat. It's overcooked and heavily charred.
An axe made in the likeness of the Little Wing Grand Prix winner, Kakka. Awarded by members of the Kasch people to honor him.
A super high-end custom axe made from the horn of a Bil De Vear.
A top-of-the-line, custom axe, fashioned from the horn of a Bil De Vear and featuring the same destructive capabilities.
An axe with red blades that harbor madness. It strikes with a gale's fury.
A powerful, high-spec axe geared toward advanced users, its powerful specs are balanced well with ease of use.
An axe forged in the image of a green dragon from Neudaiz legends. It is said to smash through evil lands with the power of the green dragon.
A super high-end custom axe powered by multiple large-capacity reactors, its enormous double blade cuts wide swaths of destruction.
An axe made in honor of Laia Martinez, the leader of the GUARDIANS. It is filled with compassion for the Gurhal System and its future.
A super high-end custom axe with an aggressive blade, it is said that its victims rarely remain in one piece.
An axe that looks like candy on a stick. A futuristic treat that can defeat opponents with its smell and bite.
An axe said to eat souls. While it confers power, it also darkens the spirit.
A luxurious axe studded with gemstones of various sizes. Enemies damaged by the large heart-shaped gemstone will have their heart stolen.
An axe equipped with a sharp auger made from a precious ore. Its power is so unthinkable that it even inflicts massive damage to its user.
A unique axe modeled after a children's toy. Hand-crafted by masters, only the best reach this level.
A beautiful axe made by an artist to express his love of the night. When the moon grows full, this axe will reveal its true form.
An axe that uses highly concentrated photons. The photon blades extending from both ends can mow down enemies in a single strike.
An impressive axe with a shape that hearkens back to days of yore. A struggle to lift for most, but its destructive power is unparalleled.
Twin Sabers modeled after the Blade called Alis. They are named after forgotten relics of the past.
The distinctive design of these twin sabers confuses enemies, giving the wielder ample time to plan his attacks and guarantee clean cuts.
One of two unparalleled blades from a homeworld.
Revolutionary twin sabers whose asymmetrical blades blend attacks like a meteor shower. The sparkle of their blades is likened to hope.
Indestructible twin sabers held by one steeped in unbounded darkness. They come, sheathed in pitch-black power, to rob the world of joy.
Limited-edition twin sabers designed with maximum power in mind, very few can control their destructive power.
Twin sabers based on designs from the earliest days of photon weapons. Each is handcrafted.
Twin sabers tuned to the highest caliber. Their output isn't stable but nothing can match their destructive capabilities.
These twin sabers reveal their true power only to the chosen. For eons, they have served as twin keys, protecting order in the world.
Twin sabers designed with attack power in mind, with a double edge for greater accuracy. Hand-crafted by masters, only the best reach this level.
Twin sabers said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. They are drawn together by a mysterious force.
Ceremonial objects with roots in "owarai," an aspect of newman culture. Their attacks do little physical damage.
Twin sabers with the power of the legendary divine beast of Neudaiz. Powerful enough to trigger natural disasters.
Super high-end twin sabers used by high-ranking military officers, their imposing form is matched by their destructive power.
Twin sabers crafted from the arms of a Delnadian. These act through the wielder in unison, augmenting their power.
A twin version of Red Saber. It seems to be a prototype, and the build quality is rough. The word "He" is engraved on the grip.
Twin sabers purified by a bearer of a sacred light. They are said to appear to those pure of heart and illuminate the world with their sacred power.
The uniqueness of these super high-end, custom-made twin sabers can only be created by the highest-grade reactor.
Super high-end, custom twin sabers made from the arms of the Deljaban. Their destructive power is immeasurable.
Replica twin sabers patterned after the earliest photon weapons.
Replica twin sabers based on designs from the earliest photon weapons.
Twin sabers created using the the cells of a powerful dark life-form. Their attacks are said to distort the laws of the universe.
The true form of Gekkavijin and Shippujinlai. Together they have the power to return order to a chaotic world.
Twin sabers with the power of galaxies. The glittering stars dance like an idol. Come audition for Gurhal Channel now.
Twin sabers used by a certain Guardian who loved music. Old fogeys don't appreciate a raging electric guitar.
Two blades of opposite natures existing in harmony, forged from the blood of two gods.
A specially designed skillet set modeled after cooking utensils from ancient times. Their culinary usefulness may be limited.
Ceremonial objects modeled after artifacts from ancient times.
Twin sabers that have undergone photon processing. They can attack with speeds just shy of the speed of light.
Twin sabers that draw out the wielder's true strength. The gleam of their blades reflect the quality of their wielder.
Twin sabers said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. Destructive weapons worthy of a knight.
These twin sabers from the underworld had their rank changed to make them more accessible. The inscription is worn and can't be deciphered.
Twin sabers that augment each other's shortcomings. Custom made by Studio Tera, they enable soaring aerial attacks.
Twin sabers modeled after the large SEED-Form "Dilnazen." The power of these blades has been amplified by a spellstone.
Twin sabers based on Kendo swords.
An axe and a sword, modified to be smaller to wield which aid in survival. Offers unparalleled slashing power.
Special twin sabers that boost the user's attack power when equipped. Grants the wielder the ability to attack like a god.
Twin sabers modeled after the large SEED-Form "Dilnazen." Made from unknown materials affected by the SEED.
Twin daggers made from nanoblasted flesh. The living blades extend from both arms, absorbing the user's life force in exchange for power.
Replica twin daggers based on designs from the earliest days of photon weapons. Hand-crafted by masters, only the best reach this level.
High-end twin daggers developed by GRM for experienced users. The easiest to use of the series.
Twin daggers made by a Parum toy company. They make cute chirping noises but can still do damage. Parental supervision is strongly recommended.
Mysterious twin daggers. Already powerful, they are said to be missing something that will complete their true form.
Super high-end, custom-made twin daggers that use the same model reactor as the De Ragan Slayer.
Daggers excavated from RELICS in a remote region on Parum. Researchers' analysis confirmed that it was originally part of a monster.
Twin daggers composed of highly compressed photons. Their red hot blades scorch the target while heating up the surrounding area.
These twin daggers of judgment rend fissures in space and time. They have absolute dominance over even the laws of physics.
Twin daggers said to control the winds. Known as the "Conquerors of the Air" for their powerful and aerodynamic slashing attacks.
Twin daggers with distinctive blades. It is said that they absorb the blood of those they cut, unleashing a gradual death on them.
Twin daggers made from Grass Assassin scythes. Attempts at blending into packs of Grass Assassins with these equipped ended badly.
Super high-end twin daggers used by high-ranking COG officials, their elegant, wing-like form belies their destructive powers.
These unique twin daggers can only be created by the highest-grade photon reactor.
Replica twin daggers based on designs from the earliest photon weapons.
Twin daggers modeled after the arms of a red ninja-type machine. They generate extreme vibrations to boost the power of slashing attacks.
Twin daggers modeled after the arms of a golden ninja-type machine. They generate extreme vibrations to boost the power of slashing attacks.
Twin daggers created by the Rie Tanaka workshop based on Gurhal legends. One daggers represents good and the other represents evil.
Powerful twin daggers that look cool. Extremely popular among youths who love the theatrical flair of these weapons in action.
Twin daggers so light that their wielder appears to dance as if whirling on wind.
Twin daggers modeled after a tool used by assassins long ago. Their attack range is short, however.
Twin daggers fashioned by famed designer Takemitsu. Ideally used in tandem with the twin handguns Kanon Quolia for maximum effect.
Twin daggers that combine gauntlets with blades. Thanks to a special manufacturing process, they spread burning photons into enemy wounds.
Twin daggers spiked with a harsh toxin. They require extreme caution in handling. Just touching the blade could be fatal to the weak.
Twin daggers modeled after the arms of a Shinowa Beat. Lightweight and low in power, but sometimes they can strike an enemy's weak point.
Twin daggers made by a Parum toy company. They make cute chirping noises but can still do damage. Parental supervision is strongly recommended.
Super high-end custom twin claws with a large-capacity reactor. They require strength to use, but their destructive power is unmatched.
Twin claws made for CASTs to use. Created by modifiying a Phyteuma to be used with both hands. Their range is immeasurable.
TENORA WORKS's twin claws from the City Defense Project. Photons concentrated on the five fingers form high-density photon blades.
Twin claws made for CASTs to use. Created by modifiying a Gabridant to be used with both hands. Their power is immeasurable.
Blades of a Grinna Bete S combined with Grinna Bete EX parts to create a powerful weapon.
Twin claws developed by Tenora with an emphasis on the design by Boaboa. Includes stitching that uses golden strands from Rappy wings.
Limited-edition twin claws with top-level power output, their elegant form hides their destructive power well.
Mechanical twin claws from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. Upgraded by a legendary Newman.
Special twin claws that can suck blood. Based on the Vampire King Poko from fairy tales.
High-end custom twin claws with an upgraded reactor, used by high-ranking COG Servants. A single claw packs unsurpassed power.
Twin claws that were originally used as work gloves for factory machines. Their ability to easily break through iron plating is amazing.
The innovative design of these twin claws makes striking at an enemy's vitals that much easier. Wear on both hands to hide amongst the fauna.
Twin claws used by a legendary assassin. The hatred of the assassin dwelling inside overrides the user's will, sending them into a beserk rage.
Twin claws modeled after the hands of a gatekeeper to another world. To use them is to offer one's own body in exchange for power.
Mass-produced twin claws with a popular, minimalist design.
Twin claws modeled after the hands of a gatekeeper to another world. Satisfy the dark power that resides within them, or suffer the consequences.
Super high-end custom twin claws with three claws each, their power is enough to behead enemies with a single slash.
Twin claws featuring likenesses of the heads of Faz'ntar and Seg'ntar. If one breaks, the other is said to shed tears.
Twin claws crafted from the paws of a Jigo Booma. Very valuable due to the difficulty of collecting paired paws without damaging them.
Replicates the power of a devil from a far off land.
Twin claws modeled after the arms of a sinister monster. It is said to be a cursed weapon created by making a deal with the devil.
Twin claws said to have a sinister monster sealed within. The malice held inside would surely cause the weak-willed to be consumed in an instant.
Beautiful twin claws with a refined and streamlined form. They are as light as feathers, so you can attack with the elegance of a ballroom dancer.
These twin claws crafted from the paws of a Go Booma are covered in fluffy fur that feels great to the touch.
A saber wielded by the Captain of the Landeel.
A saber with a distinctive design. Originally an exhibit piece, it was found to be useful for combat and has become a highly treasured weapon.
This cutting-edge saber contains a calamitous spirit that thrives on extinction. Used incorrectly, the weapon can consume its wielder.
A very high-end saber built with the finest parts and tuned for advanced users.
A prototype saber that requires a high level of skill to use effectively.
A replica saber based on designs from the first photon weapons.
A saber tuned to the highest caliber. Its output isn't stable, but nothing can match its destructive capabilities.
A demonic saber that knows no mercy. Its scarlet blade points its wielder unerringly toward absolute dominance.
A saber that is considered the magnum opus of famed swordsmith Jou'un. It has survived many years without sacrificing its power or beauty.
Composed of dark infection cells, this living saber will infect its wielder and feed off their flesh and blood.
A saber crafted from a Delnadian's arm. Its power comes from a potent interaction between live cells on its surface and the blade.
What if he stunned?
A blade forged from the blazing blood of the god of fire.
A super high-end, custom-made saber used by high-ranking military officers.
A red blade with an embossed seal.
A blade forged from the frigid blood of the god of water.
A blue blade that is fit for massacre.
A saber used by a certain Guardian who loved music. Old fogeys don't appreciate a raging electric guitar.
A saber lit by the stars of night. Their glint off the blade catches the eye.
With its latent power released, this saber shines a brilliant gold. It can boost the morale of the entire party.
A replica of an ancient artifact thought to be the forerunner of the Photon Saber.
A saber created using the the cells of a powerful dark life-form. One swing will produce a far reaching void of darkness.
A superlative saber, said to contain a sacred spirit. It lay undisturbed for ages in the place to which the souls of the planet's defenders return.
A saber named after raging winds and thunder. Its other half is said to be somewhere out there.
A replica saber patterned after the earliest photon weapons.
A saber crafted from the wood of a massive cherry tree from Neudaiz. They say these are popular gifts among young rogue men.
The uniqueness of this super high-end, custom-made saber can only be made by the highest-grade photon reactor.
A saber said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. It bears the inscription, "Kiko'ku AUW2018."
A replica saber based on the earliest photon weapons.
A saber used in battle by "The Order of the Steel Flower," a private military company. The blade of a sage, it is said to select its bearer.
A blade formed from the fusion of photons and solid ice. Those unworthy to wield this blade are rumored to be frozen upon touching it.
A saber that has undergone photon processing. With its overwhelming attack power, it draws out the wielder's hidden strength.
A saber created specifically for maximizing combat ability. Its forked blade ravages stabbed enemies from the inside.
A weapon cobbled together from a giant sword and gun with no thought for balance.
This saber may be used to scale any obstacle with ease. Made from steel forged by Studio Tera. Its attacks are as piercing and swift as the wind.
Melton's frying pan, shaped like an ancient cooking instrument. This one can be used for more than cooking.
A ceremonial object modeled after an artifact from ancient times.
The wielder of this saber need feel no fear. Made of steel forged by Studio Tera. It lashes out with the violence and power of a savage beast.
A saber modeled after the large SEED-Form "Dilnazen." It is unknown who created this mysterious weapon or what materials were used.
A concealed weapon favored by dandy ronin. Don't let its appearance fool you.
A spine-chilling saber said to have been carried by a ghost on a drizzly night. It strikes terror in your enemies.
A legendary saber used by valkyries. It is said to have overwhelmed those who observed its distinctive shining blue light on the battlefield.
A saber that brings together both elegance and subtlety. Its other half is said to be somewhere out there.
A powerful dagger made from nanoblasted flesh. Its blade mysteriously pulsates.
A high-end dagger developed by GRM for experienced users. Upgraded to the highest standard in an attempt to expand market share.
A replica dagger based on designs from the earliest days of photon weaponry.
A dagger made by a Parum toy company. It makes cute chirping noises but can do real damage.
The ultimate dagger, shrouded in mystery due to barely anyone having it. Its abilities are unknown.
A super high-end, custom-made dagger that uses the same model reactor as the De Ragan Slayer. Its size belies its sheer destructive power.
A dagger made by a Parum toy company. It makes cute chirping noises but can do real damage.
A dagger excavated from RELICS in a remote region on Parum. Researchers' analysis confirmed that it was originally part of a monster.
A dagger with a distinctive blade. The red, scar-like line on the handle absorbs enemy blood, immediately putting them to death.
A dagger modeled after a tool used by assassins long ago. Its high accuracy and evasion make quick work of enemies.
A dagger made from the skin of a huge Stateria known only from legends. It's incomplete but has immeasurable power.
A dagger made out of the scythe of a Grass Assassin. Modified for ease of use, and also serves as makeshift camouflage.
A dagger thought to have been used by a RELICS guard. While on the small side, it's capable of unleashing attacks at high speed.
A super high-end dagger used by high-ranking COG officials. The elegant, wing-like form belies its destructive power.
Its unique blade can only be created by the highest-grade photon reactor, which is what makes this limited-edition dagger so popular.
A dagger thought to have been used by a gravekeeper. It is said to have been made with the bones of the dead.
A replica dagger based on designs from the earliest days of photon weaponry.
A dagger modeled after the arm of a red ninja-type machine. It generates extreme vibrations to boost the power of slashing attacks.
A dagger modeled after the arm of a golden ninja-type machine. It generates extreme vibrations to boost the power of slashing attacks.
A lightweight dagger that gives the sensation of flying. They say that its wielder dances around as if riding on the wind.
A dagger created by the Rietanaka workshop based on Gurhal legends. It is said to represent an evil heart.
A dagger composed of highly compressed photons. Its red hot blade scorches the target while heating up the surrounding area.
An especially well made dagger from master craftsman Tengai. Purified by a being who controls lightning called "Ryujin" from Neudaiz legends.
A powerful dagger that looks cool. Creates that keep-your-distance attitude that suits the wild thing in you perfectly.
A dagger that combines a gauntlet with a blade. Thanks to a special manufacturing process, it spreads freezing photons into enemy wounds.
A dagger spiked with a deadly toxin. It requires extreme caution in handling. Merely touching the blade could instantly incapacitate the weak.
A dagger with a wide blade. It has built-in AI that can link with the user to enhance their reflexes.
A dagger modeled after the arm of a ninja-type machine. Its photon blade easily cuts through rocks.
A super high-end custom claw with a large-capacity reactor. It requires strength to use, but its destructive power is unmatched.
A claw made for CASTs to use. Its advanced weapon design based on artificial mechanics has resulted in achieving the maximum level of power.
A powerful, high-end claw geared toward the advanced user. Its elegant form hides a deadly efficiency.
A claw developed by Tenora with an emphasis on the design by Boaboa. Uses materials with superior photon conductivity.
A claw made from stolen technology. Like the original, photons concentrated on the five fingers form high-density photon blades.
A mechanical claw said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. It is said to have belonged to a legendary newman.
A claw from a puppet on an educational program on Gurhal Channel 5. While popular for its cute looks, it was deemed dangerous and fell into disuse.
A claw from a puppet on an educational program on Gurhal Channel 5. Despite scaring children, it has become popular as a weapon.
A claw modeled after the hand of a gatekeeper to another world. Those that use it must put their right hand as surety.
A claw modeled after the hand of a gatekeeper to another world. The darkness within consumes the bearer's body and soul in return for power.
A super high-end custom claw with three points. Its power is enough to behead enemies with a single slash.
The innovative design of this claw makes striking an enemy's vitals that much easier. The armor's bright colors are used to lure enemies.
A claw made only for slicing enemies apart. It is efficient and deadly in use.
A glove originally used by factory machinery which was converted into a weapon. Though it has no precision, it can slice through even iron plating.
High-end custom claw with an upgraded reactor, used by high-ranking COG Servants. Packs unsurpassed destructive power.
A claw used by a legendary assassin. Its sharp blade swiftly and silently kills the target.
A claw crafted from the paw of a Jigo Booma. Commands a high price among collectors for the creature's rare fur color.
A single-horned, red claw. Both its maker and origin are completely unknown. It seems to be one of a pair, however.
A double-horned, blue claw. Both its maker and origin are completely unknown. It seems to be one of a pair, however.
Creeping terror took shape in this weapon that tears apart all it encounters.
A claw forged in the flames of the Eclipse Torch transcribed in ancient documents. Among adventurers, it goes by the name of Alice Claw.
A claw crafted from the paw of a Go Booma. Covered in fluffy fur that makes it feel great to the touch.
A GRM whip originally developed for military use. Utilizes a rare metal to stabilize firepower and accuracy, and to boost durability.
A custom-tuned whip from a limited production run. Very few people are able to handle its destructive capabilities.
A serpentine whip that extends itself to quickly land a critical hit on the target's vitals. The path it traces in the air seems to fill all space.
A luxurious whip studded with sparkling gems that hold a mysterious power. Those touched by the sparkles will have their heart stolen.
A whip made from the tentacle of a SEED-Vitace. Although it is not very hard to use, women are not terribly fond of this weapon.
A custom-spec whip with a venomous snake motif. Difficult even for experts to handle, it is said to be dangerous for beginners to wield.
A whip developed independently by GRM, with exceptional power and the ability to inhibit its targets' movements.
A super high-end, limited edition whip with a circulating blade that constantly provides maximum output.
A whip made from the head of an Alterazgohg. The most powerful of the Gohg genus, this whip exhibits fierce and divine power.
A whip with a design based on a legendary creature of Moatoob. The sound it makes when attacking is able to charm even the dead.
A whip tipped with a Jaggo lure for fishing buffs. Be sure to return the lure to the Jaggo after use so that it does not get eaten.
A whip with a design based on De Ragan. Its power is unmatched, thanks to proprietary Tenora technology.
A whip made from the tentacle of a Dilla Griena. Though useless as a computer-hacking tool, it's great for sowing confusion among enemies.
A special whip combining a saber with a whip. Lures hostiles in with its appearance, only to strike them down from range.
A whip with a spiked ball on the tip, said to be the weapon of giants of legend. No armor can withstand its blow.
A high-output, high-end whip for advanced users. Equipped with a light but tremendously powerful reactor.
A rose-shaped weapon cultivated from photons. The whip unleashes countless blades that can cut through steel.
An ancient whip excavated from RELICS. According to legend, it was made from the bones of the Evil God King.
A whip newly developed by TENORA WORKS using non-solidified photons. Requires a certain level of skill to use.
A special whip combining a saber with a whip. Its crimson blade is testament to its having slain and absorbed the powers of many victims.
A slicer with ancient writing on it: "Quick as the wind, silent as the forest, aggressive as fire, and steadfast as the mountains."
A slicer capable cutting through the soul.
Silent, with this slicer in hand the ninja creeps among shadows. It is his way.
A slicer developed as a personal cooling fan by the adventurer Shalo, who detested heat. Despite the cute Rappy motif, it is quite sharp.
A huge slicer that strikes like a flash of lightning. It fires a sharp blast that can mangle even the largest foe.
A striking weapon called a slicer, newly developed by Yohmei Corp. Attacks its target with a flying photon blade. Difficult to use.
A slicer with an ominous shape, created by an engineer who lost loved ones to a native creature attack. Its destructive power is unmatched.
A top-of-the-line slicer developed by Yohmei Corp. Its performance is unmatched, but only a few were produced due to its high cost.
A slicer with top-class attack power. A mysterious weapon that can only be wielded by one with a strong sense of justice.
A slicer carried by the "protector" of the Kasch tribe. Only the chosen warriors who defend the Earth God are allowed to use it.
A mystical slicer whose central orb becomes a glowing mass of gravity blades. Imbued with the forger's strong love for his homeland.
A slicer that was forged at extremely high temperatures. Its red blades are a testament to its power, burning with purifying flames.
This slicer, with its fluffy photons, is both a weapon and a fashion statement. Its use as a fan has gained some popularity in recent years.
A high-powered slicer made from condensed lightning energy. You can unleash attacks, both gentle and severe, with the composure of a god.
A slicer used by Kasch guards. Made of a light material, when an enemy is spotted, you can immediately make a preemptive strike.
A slicer based on a vehicle said to transport the dead, often depicted in Neudaiz drawings. Its blade paints a blazing trail in the air.
A starfish-shaped slicer. It is capable of mowing down all hostiles.
A slicer made from Rappy feathers. The beautiful feathers have a fluffy allure that you can't help but touch.
A slicer said to never have left the hand of a dancer. It speaks of elegance.
A slicer made by a researcher consumed by an obsession of total destruction. Its array of photon daggers inflict horrific damage.
More than anything else, this slicer specializes in "crushing" its targets. It uses ultra-high density compressed photons to smash everything.
A proud protector of the village.
A slicer unearthed from a Neudaiz RELICS site. Some scholars theorized it was once used as currency, but the truth remains unknown.
A slicer with a mysterious shape that was originally used to perform rituals. It is capable of unleashing powerful whirlwinds.
A rifle from GRM's new weapons development project. Due to its huge barrel, it requires training, but boasts high accuracy and power.
An antique model that remains incredibly popular among some maniacal segments. Despite its age, its performance is on par with modern weapons.
An improved A-35 rifle. Revised by top government scientists, it is extremely efficient.
A rifle with a unique design based on an ancient military artifact. A deadly piece of precision weaponry.
A rare rifle that fires superheated bullets. Efficiently cooled by a photon booster, it highly pressurizes photons.
A rifle with a photon blade barrel. A premium product for highly ranked military only.
Although large, this rifle is smooth to turn and aim. It is powerful and extremely easy to handle.
A rifle that displays its power with its bright red body.
A super high-end, prototype rifle powered by an experimental reactor. It boasts the ultimate in sheer power.
A high-end rifle built with the finest parts and tuned for advanced users. Its high specs are balanced well with ease of use.
A top-of-the-line custom rifle rumored to have played a part in high-profile assassinations.
A rifle created as a masterpiece for a chosen few. Known for its bright glow and its amazing firing speed.
A rifle used by the soldiers of a faroff country. It's said to boost the fellowship of its users.
A high-powered rifle developed in secret for the AMF special forces. Its destructive power is unmatched.
An upgraded rifle based on an old mass-produced model. Popular for its practicality and available options.
A high-grade rifle crafted with focus on precision. Its aim is inescapable.
The man known as the "god of hunting" always kept this rifle within easy reach. Its high-impact shots pierce targets with deadly accuracy.
A rifle that fires blades, not bullets. A specialized model with high accuracy and power.
A rifle that's jet black from the barrel to the grip. Its superior accuracy lets few targets escape from its sights.
An enhanced Holy Ray rifle. Pressurized photons boast overwhelming firepower. Lightweight and easy to handle.
A rifle that boasts of top-rank abilities. Such a rare model that simply owning one puts you in a similar class.
A rifle given more punch by extending its barrel. It has a straightforward design, free of photons.
A corroded shotgun with puzzling origins. Its inky black bullets destroy enemies' souls.
A shotgun of the Missouri series, which has a deeply entrenched fan base. Fitted with many batteries, its powerful attacks inspire awe.
A super high-end custom shotgun made from the shell of a wild beast.
A launcher from a Grinna Bete EX repurposed as a powerful shotgun.
A shotgun used in the old era. Its performance is bettered by few modern weapons.
A popular summer toy known as a "water gun." Little kids and big kids can play with it. Parents can play too!
A shotgun with 90% machined parts. Low photon consumption suits it for long-term use. Highly customizable.
A mid-grade weapon used by Border Break: Air Burst support troops. It exhibits amazing power, particularly at point-blank range.
A powerful high-spec shotgun geared toward advanced users. Its powerful specs are balanced well with ease of use.
A legendary shotgun, said to be head and shoulders above the rest. Its strong recoil demands outstanding strength of its wielder.
A super high-end custom shotgun powered by multiple reactors. Its power is enough to annihilate almost any target.
A shotgun from unknown origins. It appears to be covered with an immense amount of salt...
A shotgun using the antiquated technology of steam-driven power with photon augmentation. Its power compares favorably with modern designs.
A super high-end custom shotgun made from the shell of a wild beast. Allegedly.
GRM's City Defense Project shotgun that had its rank changed to make it more accessible. Its firepower is less than that of the original.
A super high-end custom shotgun replica modeled after an antique weapon. It is, however, just as powerful as any modern counterpart.
An old shotgun used by rogues, revamped with the latest tech. Special photons are incorporated to maximize balance.
A lovely, dare we say cute, shotgun that takes aim directly at a target's heart. Whether it hits or not is entirely up to you.
A shotgun that feeds upon the void in the bearer's heart to fuel its vision of total annihilation. Beware, lest you be consumed.
A shotgun patterned after a medieval Neudaiz tool called an "umbrella." Its abilities as a weapon are unknown.
A shotgun used by 0gi. Though its specs are pedestrian, it is balanced and easy to use.
A longbow forged in the image of a red dragon from Neudaiz legends. It is said to penetrate the vilest of flames with the power of the red dragon.
A super high-end custom longbow with a large-capacity photon reactor. Its elegant form hides an enormous destructive power.
A longbow with an unknown maker. It may have been owned by a protector of RELICS. Its arrows have the power to split the sea.
A masterpiece of a longbow created for use by a chosen few. Known for its bright glow and its amazing firing speed.
A legendary longbow said to have been created by a love-struck photon researcher.
A powerful, high-end longbow geared toward the advanced user. Its elegant form conceals a deadly efficiency.
A cute longbow that fires Polty and is popular among ladies. With good form, it will always shoot straight to the enemy.
This wondrous longbow is more than legend--its power transcends time and space. Other than the inscription, "MANA", little is known about it.
This longbow of legend is mentioned within a lost ancient tome. Said to have been used by a princess as she sang.
A super high-end longbow that fires unique photon arrows that can only be created by its top-of-the-line photon reactor.
A new longbow designed by a new company. Every part of it has a purpose, and you can take an accurate shot from anywhere.
GRM's latest model longbow. The rim is made of 4 flat photons, so that even newmans can utilize its high power.
A custom-made, super high-end longbow created for the head of the Gurhal faith.
This longbow is a giant wing of a Rygutass. The huge beast's strong flying ability is surely reflected in the unwavering flight of its arrows.
A longbow created from the body of a Zamvapas. Its arrows shock targets with a Stateria's electric aura as they pass through them.
A longbow made from remnants found in a RELICS site. An improved model with higher accuracy and power. Its form is highly popular.
A longbow said to have been used by a warrior burdened with a tragic fate. Loaded with gunpowder, its arrows explode upon impact.
An excavated, unidentified longbow. According to one theory, it was left behind by a fallen meteorite. Its sinister form strikes fear in those who look at it.
A grenade made from modifing a mechanical weapon part. Power and accuracy are greatly increased after refining raw materials.
Grinna Bete S grenade repurposed for people. Since becoming popular among collectors, the number of housefires is increasing.
An ultra-efficient grenade made with the latest technology. Popular for its namesake bullets which glitter like shooting stars.
A Father's weapon disguised as a case for a musical instrument. It is said to play a beautiful requiem for its children.
A short-range grenade for people who like to get up close and personal in combat. Though risky, the power is often worth it.
A visually arresting grenade with the likeness of a Zoal Goug head. Its ferocious roars startle not only enemies but often the wielder as well.
A highly flexible grenade. Despite its curvy barrel, it aims and shoots true.
A grenade made from modifing a mechanical weapon part. A high-grade item made by exquisitely precise equipment.
This grenade that shoots Mini Rappies is popular with the ladies for its adorable looks.
A grenade developed by GRM. Includes aim-assist functionality for slightly improved accuracy.
Super high-end custom grenade made from the shell of a wild beast. Somewhat poor stability, but phenomenal destructive power.
A grenade modeled after an ancient throwing toy. Its roots lie in a long-forgotten sport called "base-ball".
Dark energies have corrupted this grenade. Made by the great hunter Kireek. Its power when it binds to its wielder's arm is staggering.
A grenade made from a monster born in another world. Enemies impaled by it have their body and spirit destroyed across the twilight.
Designed to use the same barrel as a rifle and antitank gun. The blade is good for slicing through bullets and great against slow-moving enemies.
A visually arresting grenade with the likeness of a Bil De Golus head. Some monsters mistake it to be real and flee in fear.
The beloved Puyo Puyo, now a grenade! Power is unleashed from the fleeting, ephemeral, Puyo.
The results of absurd mods, it was later officially adopted for its high specs.
Created through a now lost technology known as "biotechnology." Closely resembling a living creature, its build is disgusting and creepy.
A laser cannon once loved by a certain group. The bullets it fires are hot enough to vaporize anything.
A laser cannon well-known to be a masterpiece of destructive power. Usable only by a select few.
An AMF army prototype that uses a parabola to increase power. Its destructive power is nothing short of amazing.
A laser cannon said to bring sinners to their knees. It can release the guilt hidden deep within all men in a deep-boring merciless beam of pain.
A large laser cannon modeled after one used by the Adahna Degahna. It features tremendous destructive power on par with the original weapon.
A military laser cannon made with state-of-the-art tech. It confounds enemies with irregularly charged photons.
A laser cannon developed by Yohmei Corp. It is decorated with flower and drum motifs, and still has the most destructive power in the series.
A laser cannon used by soldiers on the battlefields of ages past. Its sheer weight is too much for most to even lift.
A super high-end laser cannon that fires multiple thin photon beams from its reactors. Capable of felling hordes of enemies in an instant.
A laser cannon used by Border Break: Air Burst heavy infantry. A specialized plasma cannon fires clusters of electrified nude particles.
Nicknamed "Black Tornado", this laser cannon's beams leave unfading wounds.
A laser cannon that belches lightning bolts. Powerful enough to fuse electricity to photons, its targets are scorched by intense heat.
An oddly familiar-looking laser cannon. It appears to make strange sounds.
A legendary laser cannon created by an outlaw. Its sole reason for existence was to be a weapon of mass destruction.
Twin handguns developed by Tenora. Uses a compressed photon explosion to fire bullets. Powerful enough to pierce a De Ragan's Scales.
Historic artifacts from the last civilization, these legendary twin handguns are said to have the volition to rip through all hostile enemies.
A pair of guns that work perfectly in concert with one another.
Shake these maracas to a samba rhythm to unleash countless shockwaves that will decimate your enemies.
High-end twin handguns built with the finest parts and tuned for advanced users.
Super high-end custom-made twin handguns created for an antique-loving AMF officer.
Twin handguns with high obsidian content. Their honed barrels support their power.
Odd twin handguns that fire from the forearms. They fires rings of compressed photons.
Twin handguns produced to cash in on the popularity of the endearing Sand Rappy. Having two of them doubles your pleasure.
Twin handguns made with the super-technology of another dimension. When fired, pillars of light fall to extinguish all things.
Perfect for a hot dog or burger.
A pair of gag gifts, with gloves shaped like guns. Hand-crafted by masters, only the best reach this level.
Twin handguns said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. Next to nothing is known about this mysterious weapon.
Antique models that remain astoundingly popular among a lunatic fringe fan base. Their performance is on par with modern weapons.
Super high-end, custom-made twin handguns powered by the highest grade reactors available.
Super high-end twin handguns powered by cutting-edge photon reactors. They possess a fluid form and explosive destructive power.
Twin handguns used in battle by "The Order of the Steel Flower," a private military company. Protects allies with its bullets of friendship.
Twin handguns said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. One of the strongest weapons of the old world.
Twin handguns with a stylish geometric shape. Though small, they can unleash unimaginable power.
Twin handguns made from a legendary ore. A precious weapon that uses primitive photons.
Very powerful twin handguns that only a select few were allowed to carry. It's said to give one squad the power of the entire army.
Pocket-sized twin handguns. Despite their tiny appearance, they pack a surprisingly powerful punch!
Twin handguns whose maker will never be known. The light that falls from heaven is called "Divine Avengement."
A historic artifact from the last civilization. Once it fires a single shot, this sleek handgun's target will surely perish.
A handgun produced to cash in on the popularity of the endearing Sand Rappy. Enjoys a good reputation for performance as a weapon.
An odd handgun fired from the forearm. It fires rings of compressed photons.
A handgun with a high obsidian content. Its honed barrel supports its power.
A super high-end, custom-made handgun created for an AMF officer with a love of antiques.
A high-end handgun built with the finest parts and tuned for advanced users. Its high specs are balanced well with ease of use.
A handgun said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. Next to nothing is known about this mysterious weapon.
A handgun made by technology from another dimension. Falling from heaven, "Divine Punishment" returns enemies to nothingness.
An antique model that remains astoundingly popular among a lunatic fringe fan base. Its performance is on par with modern weapons.
A super high-end handgun powered by the highest-grade reactor available. Its destructive power rivals the flame of a De Ragan.
A handgun said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. Next to nothing is known about this mysterious weapon.
A super high-end handgun powered by a cutting-edge photon reactor. It possesses a fluid form and explosive destructive power.
A handgun said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. One of the strongest weapons of the old world.
A handgun with a stylish geometric shape. Though small, it can unleash unimaginable power.
A handgun made from a legendary ore. Its primitive photons glimmer mysteriously in the barrel.
A handgun with endless power. Highly compressed photons form a high caliber laser that can sink battleships.
A pocket-sized handgun; very powerful despite its appearance. Its power is not to be taken lightly!
A handgun whose maker will never be known. The light that falls from heaven is called "Divine Avengement."
A super high-end custom crossbow powered by multiple reactors. The high-output reactors produce amazingly destructive power.
A fascinating crossbow made of bone that was excavated from a RELICS site. The type of bone it's made with was lost to history, however.
Kai's weapon of choice. The blade atones for the past, and the gun carries hope.
A crossbow that exudes a vile aura. Its power equals its appearance.
A crossbow made for easy handling by adopting many features of guns. Light and manageable, but its barbed photon shots are powerful.
A crossbow developed by Yohmei with an elegant design and a lightweight, high-output reactor. Offers stability when aiming.
A small white barrel crossbow.
A crossbow that a stylish ronin enjoyed using. It is incredibly sturdy and will support you when you feel exhausted.
A crossbow produced to cash in on the popularity of the endearing Sand Rappy. Enemies fooled by its harmless appearance learn a painful lesson.
A wickedly shaped crossbow that curses the hand of its user. It may have been made from alien life, but the details are unclear.
An elegant crossbow developed by Yohmei, with a lightweight, high-output reactor. A top-of-the-line model with amazing specs.
A super high-spec, custom crossbow designed by musician Neo Noove.
A super high-end custom crossbow with a large-capacity reactor. It delivers the ultimate in destructive power.
A crossbow formed from the horned head of a savage, ground-shaking beast found in a fiery cave. Its earth-pounding bolts terrify any foe.
An experimental weapon made by TENORA WORKS in order to complete their ultimate crossbow.
A top-of-the-line upgraded crossbow. While unstable, its destructive power is second to none.
A Crossbow endowed with the soul of the Phoenix. Its stardust bolts glitter like a clear night.
A spine-chilling crossbow said to have been carried by a ghost on a drizzly night. It induces cowardice in your enemies.
A card made from the feathers of a legendary god bird. Beautiful, with sharp offensive capability.
A limited-edition card with top-level power output. Its elegant form hides its destructive power well.
A card developed by GRM. Various adjustments have been made to ensure its ease of use.
A card imbued with a wish. An enigma powered by a non-photon energy source, it destroys with a mysterious, long-forgotten power.
A unique, custom-made super high-end card. It fires star-shaped blades and quickly reduces enemies to star dust.
A card developed by GRM. The improved trajectory calculation system has boosted accuracy dramatically.
A weapon that converts the wielder's energy into a deadly fan. Its effectiveness depends in large part on the user's abilities.
A super high-end card created for high-ranking COG officials. It fires blades shaped like paper dolls, with destructive results.
Super high-end, custom model card that fires pinwheel-shaped blades. Requires an experienced hand.
A super high-end, custom card modeled after flowers. It dances the dance of death on the battlefield along with its wielder.
A card capable of drawing meaning from the churning vortex of destiny. It may even show you your own future.
A card in the form of a vocalist's mic with a lovely pure-white feather and heart motif. Perfect for aspiring pop idols.
A machinegun designed from legendary blueprints. Its engineering allows it to exert tremendous power.
A machinegun with a special rotation sound. Built from GRM parts from the year AC82, many a collector would kill to own it.
A machinegun produced on a whim by a certain toy company. Utilizes hydraulic pressure to fire jets of water. It's stronger than you would expect.
A super high-end custom-made machinegun powered by the highest grade reactor. It is said that its bullets create a deadly rain.
A high-end machinegun built with the finest parts and tuned for advanced users. Its high specs are balanced well with ease of use.
A remake of a model hugely popular since its launch. Each one is custom tooled to enhance performance without ruining the original look.
A machinegun with a unique shape. It has great power, and is also useful for communication at live concerts.
A heavy black barrel machinegun.
A triggerless machinegun designed by Professor HoshinoF. It uses the latest tech to keep steady while firing.
A machinegun that damages enemies with bullets formed by the owner's intentions.
A super high-end machinegun powered by a cutting-edge photon reactor.
A Grinna Bete C machinegun repurposed for people. Its power is spectacular.
A machinegun that is compact yet powerful. Used by many CASTs, its portability makes it ideal for confined combat situations.
A machinegun said to have been loved by a notorious bounty hunter who would suddenly emerge on dark nights and drop targets without fail.
A straw doll cursed by the witch Dorothy. Turned into a machinegun, it shoots nails from its mouth. Its curse will torment even the user.
A super high-end, custom-made machinegun. It is said that its high rate of fire makes it look as though the bullets are dancing.
A rare machinegun that fires a stream of pliable, jelly-like shots. Enters "fever mode" at critical moments.
A remake of a model hugely popular since its launch. The first work of note by a young genius, its design hides considerable firepower.
A rod born through the union of faith and science. With the power to manipulate the heart, whoever holds this rod can control the world.
A powerful, high-end rod used by the COG security officers.
A super high-end, custom rod with a large-capacity photon reactor. Its elegant form hides an enormous destructive power.
The ultimate rod, created in secret by the Communion of Gurhal. It contains an enormous and evil power.
A rod that is said to give guidance to the good, and thwart the bad.
A rod used by Komazli that has been modified so people can wield it. Its power increases the effectiveness of TECHNICs.
A rod with an eye-catching design. Originally designed to protect you from the rain, it is no longer effective as an umbrella.
A replica of broom-type rods used by witches in the distant past.
A rod originally made for ceremonies. With a swing, crimson feathers dance through the wind, luring onlookers to a world of illusion.
A staff forged from the blood of fallen comrades. A gemstone from a sacred relics site has been affixed to the handle, giving it a golden aura.
A rod that commemorates the 17th president of the GUARDIANS, Obel Dallgun. His smiling face gazes up from the rod.
A rod made from the cane of a Chaos Sorcerer. Even though this cane can be used by normal people, only a fraction of its power is displayed.
A replica inspired by a rod used by an animal in a fairytale. While cute in appearance, its power is quite real. Keep away from children!
A rod that carries the aroma of the East. Made from the instrument of monks. It brings peace and purity to one's heart.
A rod made from a gigantic leaf. It's even useful as an umbrella! Rumor has it that it becomes even more powerful when in water...
A rod said to have appeared from a dimensional rift deep inside a RELICS site. The cute mascot on the end imparts courage.
"The Rappies are so cute" is what this lovely parasol rod is all about. An odd item that brings more happiness as you use it.
A gag gift modeled after a legendary creature. Not particularly useful in combat.
This superlative rod lies inside a castle said to appear within mirages. None can identify the substances within its blue, glowing photons.
A rod created from the cane of the SEED-Form "Gaozoran." An unheard-of power lies within it.
A super high-end, custom rod powered by multiple reactors. Its power blows away any enemy that stands before it.
A custom-made, super high-end rod created for the head of the Gurhal faith.
A rod carried by a vagabond of an ancient civilization. It is said that whoever wields it will control the universe.
A rod said to devour souls. It grants great power, but simultaneously eats away at mind and body.
A rod that emits strange pulsations. Developed to emulate a legendary holy staff passed down through the generations.
A rod said to have been made by the hunter Kireek from a wild beast. Beware, for the rod is always hungry, and not a picky eater.
A mysterious rod with a quarter-moon blade. The blade is more decorative than useful.
A rod once owned by the guard of the realm between life and death. There's no need to use its power to smother the light of newborn souls.
A mysterious wand that was built around the precious jewel at its tip.
The staff of a Bal Soza resized to be usable by Forces.
A wand with star-shaped amplifiers at both ends. Its cute design makes it a popular accessory.
A wand developed by GRM. An upgraded model geared toward advanced users, but it supplements the user's mental energy for ease of use.
A wand developed by GRM. The most powerful model of the series, but it supplements the user's mental energy for ease of use.
A powerful, high-end wand geared toward the advanced user. Its elegant form hides a deadly efficiency.
A super-high end, custom-made wand that uses the same model reactor as the De Ragan Slayer.
Its unique blade can only be created by the highest-grade photon reactor.
A wand adorned with precious gems. Highly efficient, they aid in the production of photons.
A wand said to have been wielded by he who is death. With absolute power over birth and rebirth, it demands subservience.
A wand crafted from the head of a savage creature that reigns over the grasslands. Its explosive power is as awe-inspiring as the real thing.
An experimental toy for young boys, modeled after a butterfly flitting across the sky. It's cute, and so much more!
A legendary wand made of a completely unknown metal.
A wand with circular guards to protect the user's hand from the dual photon blades.
A wand said to have belonged to a feared monster of Neudaiz. Its true powers are far too great for any mortal to control.
The hammer of a Bal Soza resized to be usable by Forces.
A Yohmei wand developed as part of a weapons development project. It is a reproduction of a legendary Neudaiz weapon.
A wand with a windmill shaped energy amplifier. It releases overwhelming firepower after storing wind energy.
A school bag type wand used by Clad school students.
A wand with the power of the divine beast from Neudaiz legends. It embodies the faith to the divine beast.
A super high-end custom wand with a large-capacity photon reactor. Its elegant form hides an enormous destructive power.
A super high-end custom wand made for a mogul's daughter.
A wand made from a mythical mineral. It is cloaked in a photon glow.
A treasure of the Communion of Gurhal that can only be used by top COG officials. Designed by the top engineer in Yohmei's long history.
A wand that looks down upon Gurhal from a planet of darkness. Its eye watches the fate of the world, and the hero that will eventually save it.
A wand that sucks the life from its enemies with the demon eye at its tip. Its power is immense, but it also drains the user's mental strength.
A scepter forged from the blood of slain enemies. A gemstone from a profane relics site has been affixed to the handle, giving it an evil aura.
A TCSM designed in the shape of Neudaiz. A first-class weapon due to its power, but also a popular decoration!
A TCSM crafted by mistake by one of the Photonic Forgers.
GRM's highly touted TCSM. Its performance in TECHNIC combat support is outstanding, easily making up for any user shortcomings.
A cute, yappy TCSM. It was modeled after a stuffed toy popular with children, but its power is nothing to toy with!
A TCSM in the form a fantastic denizen of the night that flies about while sparkling. Don't be left behind by this dealer of pleasant dreams.
A rare type of TCSM that can operate only in the shade. Its power is said to surpass the limits of mechanical design.

A GRM TCSM with amazing power. Usable only by a select few.
A GRM TCSM. Its cute appearance hides its amazing power.
A GRM TCSM. Its fearsome power is said to surpass even that of its user.
A TCSM by Yohmei. With limited power output, it's perfect for those who are just learning TECHNICs.
A TCSM modeled after Dol Vaveer, the photon-mind. Possesses a solemn sense of presence unusual in a support machine.
RCSM based on a Yohmei TCSM. Has a regal form and is said to bestow fear upon adversaries and serenity on its bearer.
The newest model RCSM from GRM. An excellent battle machine, with the blue shape of a deep-sea fairy.
An RCSM said to have appeared from the dream world. Truly brilliant, but powered by the life energy of people. Use in moderation.
An RCSM modeled after an artifact from a RELICS site. Full of the world's dreams, hopes, and all the latest technologies.
An RCSM said to have appeared from the dream world. Truly brilliant, but powered by the life energy of rappies. Use in moderation.
